reviewer.delegationStatement: The creator explicitly requested another more complex and attractive region without primitive buildings, and instructed Codex to increase the catalog, use more variety and make the scene coherent. This bounded visual curation executes that request; the creator has not personally reviewed these assets.

criteria.note: Inspected multiview RGB evidence supports the concrete description; missing-roof and unrelated-style candidates were excluded. Broad tree identity only; species name is an authoring handle, not a biological guarantee.

Exact retained GLB and measured material resources render successfully; source and rendered-view bytes are hash-checked. Broad tree identity only; species name is an authoring handle, not a biological guarantee.

Measured nonempty bounded geometry and renderable parts; no claim of watertight topology or engine collision quality. Broad tree identity only; species name is an authoring handle, not a biological guarantee.

Measured Y-up bottom contact supports upright ground placement; terrain pads must cover the complete footprint. No sockets or enterable interior are asserted. Broad tree identity only; species name is an authoring handle, not a biological guarantee.

Source materials and canonical RGB/base-color evidence are retained and hash-checked; final Roblox appearance requires creator inspection. Broad tree identity only; species name is an authoring handle, not a biological guarantee.
